description: This file defines the CosmosGrainStorageOptions class, which provides configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB grain persistence within the Orleans framework. It includes properties such as the storage initialization stage, whether to delete state on clear, index fields for JSON documents, and the partition key path.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB grain persistence, extending CosmosOptions with additional settings specific to Orleans storage.

methods.name: CosmosGrainStorageOptions
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new instance of CosmosGrainStorageOptions with default container name and other default values.
